test_repeat: test the utils_tf.repeat function to repeat tensor elements along a specified axis with configurable name scope
test_concat: test the utils_tf.concat function to concatenate multiple GraphsTuples along a specified axis with optional None fields
test_build_placeholders: test utils_tf.placeholders_from_networkxs to build TensorFlow placeholders from NetworkX graph data with configurable shapes and dtypes
test_stop_gradients: test the utils_tf.stop_gradient function to selectively stop gradients on globals, nodes, and edges fields of a GraphsTuple
test_fully_connect_graph: test utils_tf.fully_connect_graph_dynamic and fully_connect_graph_static to create complete edge connectivity in a GraphsTuple
